title: 1295. Find Numbers with Even Number of Digits

examples.explanation: 12 contains 2 digits (even number of digits). 345 contains 3 digits (odd number of digits). 2 contains 1 digit (odd number of digits). 6 contains 1 digit (odd number of digits). 7896 contains 4 digits (even number of digits). Therefore only 12 and 7896 contain an even number of digits.
Only 1771 contains an even number of digits.
